reproducibility_gaps: The paper reports acquisition dates but not exact Sentinel-2 Entity IDs, tile IDs, orbit identifiers, processing baselines or SAFE/GMLJP2 filenames for the four study scenes.
The paper internally conflicts on whether the original Level-1C imagery was obtained from USGS EarthExplorer or the ESA website.
The Sen2Cor processing version/baseline and exact cloud-filter/product-selection implementation are not reported beyond the less-than-10-percent criterion.
No EarthExplorer download was performed and no SAFE/GMLJP2 payload was opened; exact current scene-level retrievability was not independently exercised.
notes: R2 reflects a verified official Sentinel-2 Level-1C portal/product family plus paper-documented acquisition dates and preprocessing, while exact scene identities and acquisition-route provenance remain unresolved.
R3 is withheld because the exact study-scene payloads and product identifiers required for a scene-level reproduction path are not established.
